description: This file defines a React component for rendering a modal dialog with accessibility features, including focus management and outside click handling. It includes a portal for DOM rendering and manages event listeners for closing the modal on escape key press or outside clicks.

classes.name: PortalImpl
classes.description: A React functional component that renders its children inside a portal with close handling on outside click and Escape key press.
